# Configuration reference

Every configuration key of deskhaven, with its default and its allowed values.

There are two kinds:

- **Bootstrap keys** are read at startup. A change needs a restart.
- **Settings** change at runtime, in the console under **Settings**, and every change is
  recorded. A few settings come ahead of the feature that uses them; see
  [Known limitations](known-limitations.md#features-not-there-yet).

## Setting a value

Bootstrap keys come from, highest first: command-line flags, environment variables, the
configuration file, the built-in default.

- **File**: `deskhaven.toml` in the working directory, else `/etc/deskhaven/deskhaven.toml`,
  or the path given with `--config` or `DESKHAVEN_CONFIG`. The file is optional; an unknown
  key in it stops the server.
- **Environment**: `DESKHAVEN_` and the key in capitals, with `__` for each dot:
  `listen.client_api` is `DESKHAVEN_LISTEN__CLIENT_API`.
- **From a file**: append `_FILE` to a variable to read its value from that file, e.g.
  `DESKHAVEN_DATABASE__URL_FILE=/run/secrets/database_url`.

Durations need a unit: `90s`, `15m`, `7d`, `1h30m`.

`deskhaven config print --effective` shows every value and where it came from.

### Pinning a setting

A pinned setting takes its value from the configuration, and the console shows it read-only.
In `deskhaven.toml`:

```toml
[settings]
"auth.session_ttl" = "7d"
```

As an environment variable, the setting key follows the rule above after
`DESKHAVEN_SETTINGS__`: `DESKHAVEN_SETTINGS__AUTH__SESSION_TTL=7d`.

### In the compose deployment

All your changes go into one file, `compose.override.yaml`, next to `compose.yaml`. Merge
each snippet from these docs into it, and create the file if it is missing. For example:

```yaml
services:
  deskhaven:
    environment:
      DESKHAVEN_SETTINGS__AUTH__SESSION_TTL: 7d
```

The first time, add the file to `COMPOSE_FILE` in `.env`:

```sh
grep -q compose.override.yaml .env || sed -i 's/^COMPOSE_FILE=.*/&:compose.override.yaml/' .env
```

To run without the bundled Caddy, remove it from `COMPOSE_FILE`:

```sh
sed -i 's/:compose\.caddy\.yaml//' .env
```

Apply changes with `docker compose up -d --wait`.

## Bootstrap keys

| Key | Environment variable | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data_dir` | `DESKHAVEN_DATA_DIR` | string | `/var/lib/deskhaven` | Key pair, master key, SQLite database. |
| `database.max_connections` | `DESKHAVEN_DATABASE__MAX_CONNECTIONS` | integer | `10` | Size of the database connection pool. |
| `database.url` | `DESKHAVEN_DATABASE__URL` | secret | empty | Empty = "sqlite://{data_dir}/deskhaven.db"; or "postgres://...". May embed credentials. |
| `listen.admin` | `DESKHAVEN_LISTEN__ADMIN` | string | empty | Empty = serve admin console and admin API on the client_api listener. |
| `listen.admin_public_url` | `DESKHAVEN_LISTEN__ADMIN_PUBLIC_URL` | string | empty | Redirect target for client_api "/" when admin is split. |
| `listen.client_api` | `DESKHAVEN_LISTEN__CLIENT_API` | string | `0.0.0.0:21114` | RustDesk client HTTP API (hbbs port - 2 by default). |
| `log.format` | `DESKHAVEN_LOG__FORMAT` | one of `pretty`, `json` | `pretty` | Log line format. |
| `log.level` | `DESKHAVEN_LOG__LEVEL` | string | `info` | tracing EnvFilter syntax. |
| `public_url` | `DESKHAVEN_PUBLIC_URL` | string | empty | External base URL, e.g. "https://rd.example.com"; required for OIDC and email links. |
| `security.master_key` | `DESKHAVEN_SECURITY__MASTER_KEY` | secret | empty | 32-byte base64; empty = {data_dir}/master.key (generated, 0600). |
| `security.trusted_proxies` | `DESKHAVEN_SECURITY__TRUSTED_PROXIES` | list of cidr | empty | CIDRs whose X-Forwarded-For is honored; empty = trust none. |
| `settings` | `DESKHAVEN_SETTINGS__<KEY>` | table | empty | Pinned runtime settings (dotted keys); interpreted by the settings registry. |
| `signal.enabled` | `DESKHAVEN_SIGNAL__ENABLED` | bool | `true` | Run the embedded signal server (rendezvous, NAT test, WebSocket). |
| `signal.key_file` | `DESKHAVEN_SIGNAL__KEY_FILE` | string | empty | Empty = {data_dir}/id_ed25519 (generated on first start). |
| `signal.port` | `DESKHAVEN_SIGNAL__PORT` | integer | `21116` | TCP+UDP; NAT test uses port-1, WebSocket port+2. |

## Settings

### auth

| Key | Allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `auth.session_ttl` | `5m`–`365d` | `30d` | Absolute lifetime of client and console sessions. |
| `auth.session_idle_ttl` | `5m`–`365d` | `7d` | Sliding idle timeout of client and console sessions. |
| `auth.max_sessions_per_user` | `1`–`10000` | `100` | Most usable client and console sessions one user holds; signing in once more ends the user's least recently used session. |
| `auth.password.min_length` | `8`–`256` | `10` | Minimum password length (the maximum is fixed at 256). |
| `auth.lockout.max_failures` | `1`–`100` | `5` | Failed logins per account within the window before it is locked. |
| `auth.lockout.window` | `1m`–`1d` | `15m` | Window in which failed logins are counted. |
| `auth.lockout.duration` | `1m`–`1d` | `15m` | Base lockout duration (exponential backoff is capped at 24h). |
| `auth.ip_rate_limit.per_minute` | `1`–`10000` | `20` | Requests per minute per IP on login-type endpoints. |
| `auth.registration` | `disabled`, `invite`, `open` | `disabled` | Self-service registration mode. |
| `auth.tfa.enforce` | `off`, `admins`, `all` | `off` | Which users must enroll a second factor. A covered user without one is refused by the RustDesk client until they enroll in the web console, which asks them to at their next console sign-in. |
| `auth.email_code.enabled` | `true`, `false` | `false` | Allow email one-time codes as a second factor (requires SMTP). |
| `auth.oidc.link_verified_email` | `true`, `false` | `true` | Link OIDC logins to existing users by email only when `email_verified` is true. |

### smtp

| Key | Allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `smtp.host` | host name, at most 254 characters | empty | SMTP server host name; empty = SMTP not configured. |
| `smtp.port` | `1`–`65535` | `587` | SMTP server port. |
| `smtp.tls` | `starttls`, `tls`, `none` | `starttls` | SMTP transport security. |
| `smtp.username` | text, at most 254 characters | empty | SMTP user name; empty = no authentication. |
| `smtp.password` | secret, at most 255 characters | unset | SMTP password. |
| `smtp.from` | email address, at most 254 characters | empty | Sender address of outgoing mail. |

### devices

| Key | Allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `devices.verify_uuid` | `true`, `false` | `true` | Device endpoints check that id and uuid match the registered device. |
| `devices.require_deploy` | `true`, `false` | `false` | Accept `rustdesk --deploy` registrations. Refusing devices that were not deployed (`NOT_DEPLOYED`) is not in effect yet. |
| `devices.last_seen_flush` | `5s`–`1h` | `1m` | Interval for batch-writing device last-seen times. |
| `devices.accept_presets` | `off`, `row`, `all` | `off` | Apply the `preset-*` fields of a device's first sysinfo: `row` = owner, device group, note and strategy; `all` = also the address book entry (written as the owner). Presets let a device choose its own placement: enable only for controlled custom-client rollouts. Never applied while `devices.verify_uuid` is off. |

### addressbook

| Key | Allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `addressbook.max_peers` | `1`–`100000` | `1000` | Maximum peers per address book returned to clients (`max_peer_one_ab`). |

### audit

| Key | Allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `audit.retention.connection` | `1d`–`3650d`, or `0` | `365d` | Retention of connection audit records; 0 = forever. |
| `audit.retention.file` | `1d`–`3650d`, or `0` | `365d` | Retention of file-transfer audit records; 0 = forever. |
| `audit.retention.alarm` | `1d`–`3650d`, or `0` | `365d` | Retention of alarm audit records; 0 = forever. |
| `audit.retention.login` | `1d`–`3650d`, or `0` | `180d` | Retention of login audit records; 0 = forever. |
| `audit.retention.console` | `1d`–`3650d`, or `0` | `730d` | Retention of console audit records; 0 = forever. |

### signal

| Key | Allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `signal.relay_servers` | list of `host:port`, at most 32 | empty | Relay servers handed to clients by the signal server. |
| `signal.always_use_relay` | `true`, `false` | `false` | Force all connections through a relay. |
| `signal.require_kx_v1` | `true`, `false` | `false` | Refuse the signal KeyExchange of clients from before version 1 (one key for both directions); clients that skip the exchange are not affected. |
| `signal.acl.default` | `allow`, `deny` | `allow` | Connection ACL decision when no rule matches (not in effect yet). |
| `signal.acl.on_error` | `allow`, `deny` | `deny` | Connection ACL decision when the control plane fails (fail closed; not in effect yet). |

### Rules across settings

A change that breaks one of these is refused.

- auth.email_code.enabled requires smtp.host and smtp.from to be set
- auth.session_idle_ttl must not exceed auth.session_ttl
- auth.lockout.window must not exceed 4 × auth.lockout.duration (otherwise a single source can trip the per-username global lockout)
